Weakness.Name: Injection
Weakness.Description: The product constructs all or part of a command using externally-influenced input.

Weakness.Name: Cross-site Scripting
Weakness.Description: The product does not neutralize user-controllable input before it is placed in output.

Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags
Weakness.Description: The product receives input and neutralizes special characters, but the neutralization is incomplete.

Weakness.Name: SQL Injection
Weakness.Description: The product constructs SQL commands using externally-influenced input.
